Upstream project: Amazon Science patchcore-inspection
Upstream source: https://github.com/amazon-science/patchcore-inspection
Retained package version: PatchCore 0.1.0
Upstream license: Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE and NOTICE here).

The exact historical upstream commit is unavailable from the retained source snapshot.

The vendored Python source is in the Standard_Unconstrained_PatchCore_MVTec
experiment under official_patchcore/patchcore. A comparison against upstream
main during packaging found only patchcore/common.py differed among the retained
upstream files. This comparison does not establish the historical commit.

The BayPrAnoMeta project locally modified patchcore/common.py to use an exact
scikit-learn brute-force nearest-neighbor fallback when FAISS is unavailable.
The fallback squares Euclidean distances to preserve squared-L2 scoring and
supports saving and loading the fallback index. The experiment-specific MVTec
fitting, evaluation, and protocol adapters are BayPrAnoMeta project code.
These local changes are attributed to the BayPrAnoMeta project.

This notice and the accompanying upstream LICENSE and NOTICE cover the
vendored PatchCore source. BayPrAnoMeta's project-level license is pending.
